audit.why: Difficulty and phase-by-phase early/mid/late coverage exists and (after the chart fix below) now matches content.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer chart is entirely backwards from content and the packet: phases[0-3].side say Tristana while win[0-3]/packet say Senna, and phases[4-5].side say 'Skill' while win[4-5]/packet say Tristana, and phases[6].side says 'Skill' while win[6]/packet say Senna.
audit.why: Packet levelChart (Senna,Senna,Senna,Senna,Tristana,Tristana,Senna) matches content win[] exactly — Tristana is short-ranged/immobile pre-6 so Senna's Q wins early poke, then Rocket Jump+Buster Shot+Explosive Charge flips levels 4-5, then Senna's range/global R retakes it at 2+ items. The full-layer side/why were never updated to this and are pure template.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0-3].side and phases[6].side to Senna, phases[4-5].side to Tristana, and rewrite the why for rows 0-5 to state the real interaction (row 6's why already correctly describes Senna winning, so only its side needed the fix).
